turns.text: Explain the complete consent and data sharing flow from consent request creation until health records are received by the HIU.

must_contain: The HIU raises the consent request, the person grants or denies it in their PHR app, and the HIU then fetches the consent artefact
The HIU sends the health information request carrying the artefact, its key material and the URL to push the records to
The HIP receives that request on its callback, encrypts the records and pushes them to the HIU's data push URL, then notifies the transfer status
notes: NHA M2-M3 review, 30 September 2026: the answer covered the HIU side only; the HIP's callback, data push and notify were missing. A walkthrough must cover every party. Source lines: hiecm.flow.m3-request-consent, 'collect the consent artefact ids once they grant it'; hiecm.endpoint.m3-hiu-health-information-request, 'key material and the URL to push them to'; hiecm.callback.m2-on-health-information-request, 'id, date range, push URL and key material'; hiecm.endpoint.m2-hip-health-information-on-request, 'records and pushes them to the requester'; hiecm.endpoint.m2-hip-data-flow-notify, 'status and a status per care context'.
